subject: general
question: At Aero India 2025, the DRDO unveiled a new technology to enhance aircraft launch capabilities for the Indian Navy. What is this technology called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electro-Magnetic Launch System (EMLS)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Electro-Magnetic Launch System (EMLS) is a cutting-edge technology unveiled by the DRDO for the Indian Navy to enhance aircraft launch capabilities.
 
• EMLS employs electromagnetic force to launch aircraft from naval carriers, replacing conventional steam catapults.
 
• This technology provides greater efficiency, precision, and flexibility in launching heavier and advanced aircraft.
 
• EMLS is aligned with India's efforts to modernize naval aviation and boost indigenous defense capabilities under the "Atmanirbhar Bharat" initiative.
 
• It is a critical component for operating advanced fighters and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) from aircraft carriers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS):**

 
 
• EMALS, developed by the US Navy, is a similar system that uses electromagnetic energy to launch aircraft.
 
• It offers a smoother acceleration compared to steam catapults, reducing wear and tear on aircraft.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of EMLS:**
 
 
• Improved energy efficiency and reduced maintenance costs compared to steam-based systems.
 
• Capable of launching a wide range of aircraft, from lightweight UAVs to heavy fighter jets.
 
• Provides scalability and adaptability for future advanced aircraft designs.
 
 
 
• **Indian Navy's Aircraft Carriers:**
 
 
• India currently operates INS Vikramaditya and recently commissioned INS Vikrant, both of which will benefit from advanced launch systems like EMLS.
 
 
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat in Defense:**
 
 
• The DRDO's development of EMLS reflects India's commitment to self-reliance in defense technologies.
 
• It reduces dependency on foreign suppliers and strengthens the domestic defense manufacturing ecosystem.
